# zone_dns_zone (Resource)

Settings of an existing DNS zone.

~> **This resource does not create or destroy zones.** The zone.eu API has no endpoint for either: a zone appears when a domain or hosting service is bought and goes away with it. Applying this resource adopts the zone that already exists and manages its settings; destroying it stops managing those settings and leaves the zone in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopts the zone that already exists for a domain or hosting service. This
# resource never creates or destroys zones; the API cannot.
resource "zone_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
  ipv6 = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, for example `example.com`. Changing this adopts a different zone.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu serves this zone.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu's IPv6 support is enabled for this zone.

### Read-Only

- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether the zone is DNSSEC signed. Managed by zone.eu, not by this provider.
- `resource_url` (String) API URL of this zone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a zone by name.
terraform import zone_dns_zone.example "example.com"
```
